futebolplotR: Brazilian Soccer Badges Plots in 'ggplot2'

Source: R/futebolplotR-package.R, R/geom_futebol_badges.R
futebolplotR-package.Rd

A set of functions to visualize Brazilian Soccer analysis in 'ggplot2'.

Usage

GeomFUTbadge

Format

An object of class GeomFUTbadge (inherits from Geom, ggproto, gg) of length 5.
